document_metadata.title: 11、EXT. NOTRE DAME -- DAY
document_metadata.summary: Sami Zerhouni, a small-time hustler, attempts to steal from tourists in a plaza but is caught when a woman zips his arm in her bag, rips out his hair, and hits him with her purse, causing him to flee as police approach.

entities.name: Woman attacks Sami Zerhouni with her purse
entities.description: After noticing Sami's hand in her purse, the woman pulls away, rips out more of his arm hair, and strikes him forcefully in the face with her bag, knocking him to the ground.

entities.description: After being hit by the purse, Sami collapses onto his back, causing numerous wallets and billfolds to spill out from his pockets.

entities.description: Realizing he is about to be caught, Sami abandons the stolen wallets, stands up, and runs away into the crowd after spotting two police officers heading toward him.

document_metadata.summary: Zero defies Ellwood's order, reveals his gun, and kills him with a single shot; he and Daniel leave with the suitcase, while Lamar follows and the oblivious man finds the hidden gun.

entities.name: Ellwood displays weapons from open suitcases
entities.description: Ellwood sits on a bed surrounded by open suitcases containing various weapons, presenting them to Daniel and others present.

entities.name: Daniel inquires about price of nine-millimeter pistols
entities.description: Daniel examines the available weapons and asks Ellwood how much the nine-millimeter pistols cost.

entities.name: Daniel requests additional ammunition and clips
entities.description: Daniel tells Ellwood he needs extra magazines and bullets along with the firearms he intends to purchase.

entities.name: Daniel begins counting out money for purchase
entities.description: Daniel starts handling cash, preparing to pay for the weapons and ammunition he has requested.

entities.name: Ellwood aims .357 magnum at Daniel and companions
entities.description: Ellwood suddenly points a .357 magnum revolver at Daniel and the others, shifting the situation from a sale to a confrontation.

entities.name: Lamar protests Ellwood's betrayal of trust
entities.description: Lamar reacts with shock and anger when Ellwood draws his weapon, reminding him that he gave his word to ensure their safety.

entities.name: Ellwood reveals bounty offered by Zammito
entities.description: Ellwood explains he intends to betray Daniel and Zero because Zammito is offering twenty thousand dollars per person, far more than the current deal.

entities.name: Ellwood orders Daniel to place gun on floor
entities.description: Ellwood commands Daniel to slowly take out his firearm and lay it on the floor as part of the confrontation.

entities.description: Daniel complies with Ellwood's order but subtly kicks his gun under the bed after placing it on the floor.

entities.name: Ellwood corrects Daniel's placement of the gun
entities.description: Ellwood objects to Daniel kicking the gun under the bed, insisting it remain visible on the floor as originally ordered.

entities.description: Ellwood speaks slowly and enunciates clearly so his deaf cousin can read his lips, directing him to fetch the gun from under the bed.

entities.name: Cousin searches under bed for the kicked gun
entities.description: Ellwood's cousin gets on his hands and knees and begins looking under the bed for the weapon Daniel had kicked there.

entities.name: Daniel exchanges meaningful glance with Zero
entities.description: As the cousin searches under the bed, Daniel looks over at Zero with a deliberate, communicative expression suggesting a plan or understanding.

entities.name: Ellwood aims gun at Zero

document_metadata.title: 210、EXT. BRIDGE -- AFTERNOON
document_metadata.summary: The group discovers Van Gogh's 'Vase with Twelve Sunflowers' under a canvas, but a passing truck's wind blows it into the river before they can save it.

entities.name: Marcel apologizes for failing to check the money
entities.description: Marcel expresses regret for being caught up in the excitement and not verifying the money, acknowledging his mistake and challenging the others about their own past errors.

entities.description: Sami takes the autographed baseball that Marcel had taken from Zammito out of the black canvas bag and comments sarcastically on their meager gains.

entities.description: Marcel asserts that the baseball belongs to him because he was the one who took it, sparking conflict among the group.

entities.name: Sami refuses to return the baseball to Marcel
entities.description: Sami forcefully rejects Marcel's claim, declaring that Marcel is not entitled to the baseball and throwing it back into the bag.

entities.name: Raymond erupts in anger at Marcel for not checking the money

entities.name: Marcel insists on retrieving the baseball despite opposition
entities.description: After the group's outburst, Marcel reiterates his claim and demands that Sami give him the baseball.

entities.name: Marcel and Sami struggle over the canvas bag
entities.description: Marcel attempts to take the bag from Sami, who resists; they tug at it until Marcel pulls hard and rips the bag open.

entities.name: Autographed baseball falls from bag and rolls into river
entities.description: The baseball slips out of the torn bag, rolls across the bridge, and drops into the river below, lost to the group.

entities.summary: A dominant enforcer relays Bastaldi's orders, confronts Sami over unpaid debts, and assigns him a job to repay; another man accompanies Daniel to the airport, while a conflict arises over changing the radio to Johnny Hallyday.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A member of the group who retrieves the autographed baseball from the bag and refuses to return it to Marcel, leading to a physical struggle.
entities.summary: Various individuals interact with Marcel's crew: a fearful debtor, a rumor-s spreading assault victim coerced into a job, a newcomer detailing criminal ties, a restless limo passenger, a peacemaking handshake offeror, and a quietly admiring crew member upon meeting Sophie.

entities.summary: A mysterious, intense figure with a rock-star look joins a group involved in a high-stakes operation, engages in a radio dispute, defies rules, and participates in a coordinated entry while noise issues arise in the apartment.

entities.name: Raymond Gayet
entities.description: A member of the group who erupts in anger at Marcel for failing to check the money, expressing intense frustration.
entities.summary: A man navigates a tight parking space, drives nervously under pressure as an armed man approaches, walks with Daniel and Julien into a warehouse, corrects Marcel in a tense exchange about history and communication, and reassures his mother during a call, showing familial closeness.

entities.name: Daniel notices the ripped lining of the black canvas revealing a hidden painting
entities.description: Daniel observes a gust of wind lifting the torn lining of the black canvas bag, exposing Vincent van Gogh's 'Vase with Twelve Sunflowers' hidden beneath.

entities.name: Group reacts to the discovery of the hidden Van Gogh painting
entities.description: After seeing Daniel's stunned expression, the others follow his gaze and discover the priceless painting concealed under the canvas, leaving them momentarily frozen in shock.

entities.name: Truck passes by and wind carries the painting over the bridge railing
entities.description: As the group moves toward the painting, a passing truck creates a gust of wind that lifts the lightweight artwork and blows it over the bridge railing.

entities.name: Painting floats down from the bridge and lands in the river
entities.description: The Van Gogh painting drifts through the air after being blown off the bridge and settles onto the surface of the river below, out of reach.

entities.name: Daniel Foray
entities.description: A character who notices the ripped lining of the black canvas bag and discovers the hidden Van Gogh painting.
entities.summary: A man guides Julien in a dark apartment, criticizes him for lacking batteries, helps remove a painting, warns about fire, rushes to escape with Raymond, reacts to gunfire, and confronts Raymond's driving skills during a tense getaway.
